## Description

Integrates self-attention mechanisms with recurrent neural Hawkes point processes to capture complex temporal dependencies and bursty order arrival intensities for short-term alpha generation.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency order flow imbalance forecasting, event-driven tick alpha generation.

## Vehicles

High-Frequency Trading Firms, Statistical Arbitrage Prop Desks.

## Required data

Tick-level trade execution timestamps, quote cancellations, order book depth event logs.

## Caveats

Attention weight interpretation requires monitoring to prevent overfitting on transient market noise.
